programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Irma busca pretextos para no regresar a casa, pero Luigi insiste en llevarla; Omar le dice a Fernando que no le gusta nada el hecho de que Lety haya desaparecido.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Luigi le pide a Irma que le cuente la historia de su vida con Rafael; Carolina se molesta con Lety porque le dice que quiere regresar a la ciudad; Lety se encuentra un anillo y hace un ritual con el mar.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando mira con tristeza la oficina de Lety. Aldo le cuenta a Lety por qué se distanció de su padre y le dice que ve en ella un corazón con mucho dolor. Julieta se niega a darle a Fernando información sobre Lety.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Irmita les da noticias a sus compañeros de trabajo: el doctor dice que Rafael puede morir en cualquier momento.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo le dice a Carolina lo sorprendido que está con el cambio de Lety. Marcia se molesta al saber que Lety salió de la ciudad y se burla de Fernando, pero él le confirma que está enamorado de Leticia.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando se molesta con Omar y le pide que deje de ponerle apodos denigrantes a Leticia; Lety ayuda a las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza a repasar sus conocimientos generales.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza le agradecen a Lety por darles confianza y Aldo la felicita por compartir lo que aprendió con él; Jorge le hace una visita a Rafael.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Tomás se niega a decirle a Julieta por qué Lety abrió Filmo Imagen y embargó a Conceptos; Teresita le pide a Marcia no darse por vencida con Fernando.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo le confiesa a Lety que su padre se molestó con él por convertirse en chef en lugar de ingeniero y ella le expresa su admiración por ser fiel a sus ideales; Fernando busca a Lety en el bar de un hotel.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando está desesperado sin Leticia; Lety le confiesa a Aldo que no puede dejar de pensar en Fernando.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Carolina le dice a Lety que Aldo está encantado con ella. Aldo lleva a Lety a bucear y navegar. Irma presenta a su familia en Conceptos. Rebeca le informa a Luigi que quiere llevarse a Irma a Estados Unidos. Tomás acude de nuevo a la junta de Comité.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Mónica le cuenta a Marcia que vio a Fernando muy borracho en un bar y que el barman lo estaba mandando a su casa en taxi; Marcia, a su vez, se lo cuenta a Teresita y ella se aflige mucho.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Jessica le dice a Carolina que su miedo desapareció gracias a los consejos de Lety. Marcia le cuenta a Alicia que Fernando confesó estar enamorado de Lety. Aldo lleva a Lety en motocicleta por el puerto de Acapulco.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando le llama la atención a Alicia por no pasarle las llamadas y la molesta por la relación que tuvo con Tomás; Teresita le propone a Marcia una alianza para sacar adelante Conceptos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Omar le dice a Teresita quién es el dueño de Conceptos; Simón le dice a Teresita y Marcia que Fernando salió de la empresa en muy malas condiciones; Fernando se estaciona enfrente de la lancha de Aldo.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando es sacado de un bar todo golpeado, pero logra volver a entrar; Lety interviene entre Aldo y Fausto para que se reconcilien; Fausto le entrega a Aldo una carta.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety le cuenta a Carolina que pasó toda la noche con Aldo y se dieron un beso, por lo que ya no quiere volverlo a ver; Carolina le aconseja darse una oportunidad con Aldo.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo le pide ayuda a Lety para cocinar para las concursantes del certamen Nuestra Belleza; Lety le pide no hablar de lo que pasó entre ellos; Fernando le confiesa a Omar haber ido a Acapulco para que lo mataran.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Omar y Fernando hablan a la casa de la familia Padilla, pero Julieta les cuelga; las del cuartel, en compañía de Paco, Celso, Simón y Raúl, ven el certamen Nuestra Belleza por televisión.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando llega a la residencia de Jorge Flores, quien le da una fórmula para eliminar la tristeza y las angustias, con el fin de volver a ser el mismo de antes, en armonía.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: En la junta del comité, don Humberto anuncia que llegó a un acuerdo con don Erasmo para solo meter abogados en lo que concierne a la devolución de la empresa.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Sara coquetea con Sánchez y Rosales. Don Erasmo habla con Julieta y Tomás del acuerdo al que llegó con don Humberto. Los licenciados Sánchez y Rosales se presentan ante la junta de comité.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Tomás que ya perdonó a Fernando. El licenciado Santa María propone un plan para salvar Conceptos, pero Lety es la única que puede ayudarlos.

programme.title: La fea más bella

programme.desc: Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

programme.desc: While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

programme.desc: Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

programme.desc: Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best cropMrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another...and is after her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning...but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right...

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson stars as a radio station owner who builds a three-dimensional television receiver which accidentally intercepts a "galaxy being" whose strange form and deadly radiation triggers a tide of panic and violence!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a terrifyingly timely story of genetic engineering and political power plays, Sidney Blackmer stars as a popular American President who puts into place a master plan to slowly and steadily destroy the United States. James Hong also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In order to unifying the nations of Earth, a group of scientists sets out to secretly create the ultimate, global threat -- an all-powerful alien monster -- via human mutation! Robert Culp stars as the scientist chosen to undergo the transformation.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A meek, unassuming college professor (Donald Pleasence) invents a device capable of controlling the entire electro-magnetic spectrum and realizes the device has unleashed his subconscious thirst for revenge-with uncontrollable and deadly results!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Martin Landau stars as the time-traveler Andro who is desperately trying to stop the birth of a crazed 20th century inventor whose bacterium invention turns humans into hideous mutants. Shirley Knight co-stars in this classic, touching episode.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Both a cautionary tale and a tight courtroom drama, this haunting episode explores the fear and hostility that result when all privacy is eliminated...and all secrets are revealed! Jeff Corey, Peter Breck and Alan Baxter star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In an isolated, snowbound outpost where a handful of people are on alert against enemy attack, a crazed Army major (Harry Guardino) is haunted by the ghost of a soldier he left to die. Sally Kellerman co-stars in one of her earliest TV appearances.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Two rock samples in Dr. Temple's (Barry Atwater) lab conceal protoplasmic alien invaders capable of controlling a human "corpus." Enter Paul Cameron (Robert Culp)...who can telepathically hear the "rocks" plotting their take-over of the world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A six-man strike force is captured on the planet Ebon and brutally interrogated. And when they are suddenly allowed the "respect due a conquered enemy," the prisoners to conclude that there is a traitor among them...someone who must be killed!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Writer-producer Joseph Stefano creates both a macabre parable of the destructive potential of nuclear energy and a pulsating tale of terror featuring a superbly understated performance by Ed Asner. Scott Marlow and Michael Forrest also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In this highly charged, fascinating tale that explores the concept of alternate dimensions, a wealthy industrialist (Barry Jones) attempts to contact his dead son by funding a scientist's experiments in prying open the door to "the borderland."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: They creep. They crawl. They kill. When the rulers of the planet Zanti are allowed to exile their criminals to our world, the screeching misfits will demonstrate to the military just what the word "invasion" really means. Bruce Dern stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Befuddled by the strange local custom of murder, two Martian administrators (Barry Morse and Carroll O'Connor) visit Earth to study one such crime and find themselves tempted to tamper with events in this whimsical tale from "The Outer Limits."

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: Don Pascacio amenaza a los Héroes con publicar las fotos si no recibe una importante suma de dinero. Mientras tanto, Prisca toma la decisión de abandonar a Hassan para siempre.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: Escándalo alrededor de los Héroes del Norte acerca de un antro gay. En medio de chismes y amenazas, Doña Olegaria suspende todas las actividades de la banda, que regresa a la mansión y se encuentra con que deben declarar Hacienda urgente.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: Los Héroes hacen un último concierto para cerrar la deuda que tienen con la Hacienda.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: María le lleva un pastel a Doña Lucha por ser su santo, al chino al bajar unos platos encuentra la foto de su padre y le exige a Doña Lucha le confiese la verdad sobre él, ella le cuenta todo lo que vivió a lado de su padre y porque regresó a México.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: María cree que está embarazada y Albertano tiene problemas para aceptar que va a ser papá. El Macaco organiza una protesta en contra de la comercialización indebida del tamal.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: Detienen a Doña Lucha al creer que es la jefa de una banda de marchistas, para sacarla de la cárcel, sus hijos juntan sus ahorros con los que comprarían su regalo del 10 de mayo. En la cárcel los policías creen que ella mató a un delincuente.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: Le dan trato preferencial a Lucha y hasta un famoso narcotraficante se pone a sus órdenes porque cree que mató a un delincuente. Albertano se corta un mechón por el cual le dan mucho dinero. Lucha se enoja muchísimo al enterarse.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: Albertano le manda a María la llave de su cuarto para que saque sus cosas, pero ella entiende que le pide que se mude con él, con su llave tiene una pata de conejo de la buena suerte, pero al ensuciarse, María la tira y le compra una pata nueva.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: Doña Lucha aprovecha el corte de agua en la colonia para vender unas cubetas que tenía apartadas. María se pone celosa de la nueva ayudante del equipo de fútbol, Citlali, mientras que Albertano se la pasa en la banca por ser mal jugador.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Ludovico y Federica inscriben a Junior en el concurso Niños de Oro, donde participa cantando ópera, pues desean ganar el gran premio.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Ludovico sueña que está en una telenovela en la que es millonario, su mujer es la villana y termina casándose con una sirvienta.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Excelsa está embarazada, Ludovico y Federica quieren saber quién es el padre. Ludovico y Federica hacen un casting para ver quién podría ser el padre del hijo de Excelsa.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Federica tiene un enamorado secreto. Carmelita Salinas entrevista a Federica y Ludovico Peluche. Federico niega que el hijo de Excelsa sea de él.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Federica hace planes para comer con sus papás, pero Ludovico muere por ver el fútbol, así que arma una estrategia para regresar temprano a casa. En casa de sus suegros, Ludovico se las ingenia para estar enterado de cómo va el partido.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Federica se encuentra a su amiga Columba y las indirectas entre ellas no se hacen esperar; Federica quiere vengarse de que Columba y Basilio les ganaron en el dominó, los invitan a una fiesta, pero ellos a cambio de ir les piden varios favores.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Ludovico está muy triste porque Federica está terriblemente enferma; Ludovico la lleva al hospital para que la operen.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Ludovico roba a su amigo Flavio y es encerrado; Federica es llevada a la estación de policías a declarar; unos ladrones entran a la casa de la familia Peluche.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano acompañan a Lupita a la feria de su pueblo, donde la mujer se reencuentra con un pretendiente, quien de inmediato se convierte en un rival de los guapos, resolviendo el conflicto muy a la mexicana.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: A los héroes no se les hace fácil comenzar una nueva vida, mientras que estrellas del mundo grupero graban un disco en su homenaje. A Zacarías, ya convertido en solista, se le suben los humos.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: El Vítor recoge una copia de su acta de nacimiento, se da cuenta de que sí tiene papá y descubre que es millonario, por lo que se va de la casa. El dinero pondrá a prueba su gran amistad con Albertano.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano están a punto de conseguir un gran empleo, pero no se los dan porque les hace falta su certificado de estudios y deciden inscribirse en una escuela abierta.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Al intentar limpiar la computadora de Don Justo, Plutarco compra cientos de acciones a su nombre. Justito descubre que Gaby puede jugar ajedrez y la inscriben en un torneo para así solucionar los problemas económicos de los López.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Don Justo jubila a Plácido y no le da nada de pensión. Los López tratan de buscar una solución para poder vivir ahora que Plácido no tiene trabajo. Plutarco planea exigirle un buen trato a Don Justo.
programme.sub-title: Le toca bailar con la más fea

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Por accidente, Plutarco tira al administrador por las escaleras y Sinforosa decide buscar al responsable del accidente para correrlo del edificio. Renata quiere participar en un concurso de cocina, pero al no poder asistir envían a Carlos disfrazado.

programme.title: Rebelde

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón finge enfrentarse a los captores de Miguel y le ayuda a escapar. Diego intenta quitarle la credibilidad a Roberta. Franco echa a Guillermo de su casa. Gastón paga a sus cómplices y planea usar el dinero del rescate contra Miguel.

programme.title: RBD
programme.desc: José rompe con Teo porque no tienen nada en común. Sol acepta tener una relación con Diego porque le interesa su amistad con el director de una agencia de modelos. Mía le dice a Miguel que quiere hacer el amor con él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel planean pasar la noche juntos. Teo consigue convencer a José para que sigan juntos. Miguel es acusado de planear su secuestro. Iñaki inicia el rumor de que Roberta está loca. Lola promete hacerle la vida imposible a Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sus compañeros se burlan de Roberta por sus supuestas alucinaciones. La policía detiene a Miguel. Giovanni aprovecha el escándalo para hacer campaña por Diego. Gastón aprovecha para hacer dudar a Mía de Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta hará una rifa para su campaña. Lupita le dice a José que Diego va ganando en las encuestas. Mía rechaza a Gastón por intentar besarla.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón le ordena al Pato y al Cacho que declaren que Miguel los contrató para autosecuestrarse. Tomás le dice a Diego que ya no estará en su campaña.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Al sentirse traicionado, Diego hace que Giovanni elija entre él y Tomás. Lupita le aconseja a Roberta que saque a Miguel del partido, pero ella se niega. Pilar convence a Pascual que permita la rifa de Roberta. Mía duda de la inocencia de Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego descubre que Pilar arregló la rifa de Roberta. Alma es la nueva modelo de la marca de Franco. Leonardo vuelve a intentar acercarse a Lupita antes de irse del colegio. Mía descubre que hay alguien inculpando a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía sufre porque Miguel se declaró culpable y no quiere verla. Lola y Bianca se reconcilian. Roberta y Jose hacen un plan para sabotear la campaña de Diego. Lupita se comunica con la mamá de Nico al no recibir ningún mensaje de él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta intenta sobornar a Sol para conseguir una copia del discurso de Diego. Yuli le hace creer a Lupita que Karen y Nico están en Israel. Mía intenta escaparse para ver a Miguel y Gandía la expulsa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le inventa a Gandía que Gastón le pidió hacer unos trámites y por eso iba a salir, para que no la expulse. Finalmente, Mía logra visitar a Miguel en la cárcel, pero él se niega a verla.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía va a visitar a Miguel a la cárcel para pagar su fianza, pero él le dice que no quiere verla y la echa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico acusa a Luján y Roberta de ser unas estafadoras y ladronas, por lo que ambas se molestan demasiado y se agarran a golpes.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pilar le dice a Gandía que engañó a sus compañeros igual que él a su mamá; Miguel decide terminar su noviazgo con Mía; Lola le pide a Santos fingir que son novios; Yuli quiere que Alicia le entregue todas las cartas que envíe Nico para Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Galia le exige a Gandía que Pilar reciba un castigo. Teo discute con José por el Club Hípico. Raquel le dice a Roberta que si logra que corran a Pilar, ganará votos. Pilar les confiesa a todos que cometió un fraude y delata a Diego.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel se sorprende al saber todo lo que hizo Diego para ganar las elecciones; Reverte asegura que Roberta es su hija; Gandía le advierte a Gastón que se aleje de las alumnas; Teo no puede superar la muerte de su hermano a causa de un caballo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Rocco besa a Vico, pero ella lo rechaza; Teo le dice a José que sí entrará al Hípico; Pilar le agradece a Roberta que no la corrieran; Miguel le insinúa a Mía que no solo le da besos a Gastón y ella lo abofetea; Diego cae ebrio a la alberca.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma confiesa haber amado a un hombre al que jamás volvió a ver y tampoco buscó porque se embarazó; Diego recrimina a Giovanni que le haya robado dinero; Sol le advierte a Roberta que se aleje de Diego; Alma y Reverte se encuentran.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Reverte conoce a Roberta. Mía saldrá con Gastón para desenmascararlo. Reverte le inventa a Gandía que Mendiola es su amigo para que lo acepte como profesor. Vico discute con su papá. Mía ve a Romina besar a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le pide ayuda a Santos para que Romina lo deje de acosar; Giovanni trabajará en la carnicería de su papá; Diego y Tomás creen que Giovanni fue a cuidar a su papá porque está enfermo; Gastón le advierte a Hilda que no se meta en sus asuntos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Hilda encuentra a Romina y Miguel acostados en el pasto besándose; Gandía se escandaliza al ver la estatua de Roberta; Mabel le reclama a León que obligara a Diego a declarar en su contra; Alma renuncia al contrato para modelar la ropa de Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita trata de hacer que Lola sea una mujer más responsable, pero ella no planea seguir sus consejos. Franco golpea a Miguel al pensar que trató de abusar de Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se pone nerviosa al pensar que Miguel vivirá en su casa por un tiempo. Roberta le dice a Diego que Sol lo engaña y le entrega una dirección para que descubra que es verdad lo que dice.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Santos busca cualquier pretexto para estar cerca de Lupita y ella se pone nerviosa. Mía encuentra a Miguel y Romina juntos en su habitación.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pilar le llama a Mía de forma anónima para que descubra que Celina le mintió. Mía deja a Miguel afuera de su casa bajo la lluvia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sol y Pilar planean incluir a Celina en su nuevo grupo de popularidad. Lupita no quiere que Lola descubra que salió con Santos. Diego golpea a Santos. Sol termina su relación con Diego, y Agustina con Giovanni. José amenaza con golpear a Raquel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía ve un video y se da cuenta de que Celina le ha estado mintiendo para salir con un chico. León le advierte a Diego que tiene que ganar las elecciones sí o sí, o lo castigará.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía cuestiona a Celina por no decirle que anda con Alex. Es el día de la votación y gana Diego, pero José está segura de que hicieron fraude. Roberta trata de quejarse, pero la castigan y Reverte la consuela, mientras Alma los ve de manera extraña.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel está muy enfermo y Mía lo cuida a pesar de todos los problemas que tienen. Diego engaña a Roberta para llevarla a su departamento y hablar con ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Romina se queda a cuidar a Miguel. Gandía pide a Diego, Giovanni y Tomás que encuentren al ladrón de su pluma. Miguel va a la escuela y Gastón lo corre, así que se esconde. Teo va al desfile de las Top Girls y se pelea con José.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego reconoce ante todos que hizo trampa para ganar la Presidencia. Miguel logra meterse a la escuela y habla con Mía. Roberta provoca que se le caiga la falda a Raquel. Mía se presenta en el desfile, modelando y regalando ropa de la marca Colucci.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel se reconcilian y le dice que siempre soñó con volver a estar así con él. Rocco le insinúa a Giovanni que ante la careta de machito que tiene, se esconde un gay. Roberta le dice a José que se está haciendo daño.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se reconcilia con Vico y Celina. Vico enfrenta a Pilar porque se entera de que ella causó su separación de Giovanni. Miguel regresa a la escuela y todos descubren que volvió con Mía. Tomás y Giovanni creen que Roberta y Diego andan a escondidas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma sigue desconfiando de Reverte. Santos le dice a Teo que si ya no se siente bien termine con José. Roberta se entera de que Diego está diciendo que pasaron la noche juntos. Alma vuelve a ver a Octavio abrazando a Roberta y le exige que la suelte.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma explota ante Reverte y le pide a Roberta tener cuidado con él. Lola entra al cuarto de Santos en la noche y lo besa, pero él la confunde con Lupita. Gastón descubre a Mía y a Miguel besándose.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le explica a Mía que Gastón lo obligó a hacer un trabajo con Romina. Lupita le dice a Santos que la que lo besó fue Lola. Roberta le encarga a Rocco que la grabe cuando se le declare a Diego. Teo le pide a Jose que lo acompañe a ver a su mamá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita recrimina a Santos por rechazar a Lola y decirle que era por ella. Teo no resiste ver a su mamá mal y sale corriendo. Lola le dice a Lupita que la detesta. Roberta exhibe un video para demostrar que Diego y ella no tienen relaciones sexuales.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel no acepta que Franco le pague la colegiatura para que deje de ser becado; Teo le reclama a José por decirle a Gastón que tiene asma para que no lo aceptara en el equipo de fútbol; Roberta se disculpa con Diego por lo del video.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta insulta a Iñaki por inventar que Diego hablaba mal de ella. Teo le da clases de equitación a Raquel; León rechaza tajantemente la idea de Diego de dedicarse a la música. Martín Octavio quiere platicar con Roberta sobre su cuadro.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El profesor Reverte lleva a Roberta a conocer niños de la calle y así aprenda a valorar lo que tienen en la vida. Alma le reclama a Reverte por haberse llevado a Roberta sin permiso. Iñaki se vuelve el técnico de RBD.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina le asegura a Mía que Sol es una buena persona. León lleva a cabo sus planes para lograr que Diego abandone la banda. Alma descubre que Octavio tiene un hermano gemelo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego convoca a sus compañeras para que hagan pruebas y así encontrar a las suplentes de Roberta y Lupita, debido a que ellas decidieron dejar el grupo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico decide hacer la audición para ser la nueva vocalista de la banda. Lola le confiesa a Roberta el gran amor que siente por Santos. Mía logra que Sol no se quede en la banda.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Luján sufre al saber que Teo decidió terminar su relación. Diego se encela al ver a Roberta besándose con Nikki. Alma sospecha que Octavio no es el buen hombre que dice ser. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de Luján.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lola sufre al saber que Santos jamás se enamorará de ella. Diego se molesta al saber que Roberta le robó sus canciones. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para hacerle la vida imposible a Luján.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Giovanni tiene muchos problemas para escribir una carta dirigida al director. Jose se enoja con Roberta porque no le contó que Teo la engaña con Raquel. Roberta planea destruir Rebelde. Mía logra que Selina le confiese su plan.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego y sus amigos hacen un plan para que Roberta vaya a su departamento. Sol vierte pegamento en el cabello de Mía. Roberta rechaza a Iñaki porque ella no quiere tener novio. Mía les muestra a sus amigas que recuperó su cama en el dormitorio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Luján quiere renunciar a la escuela. Alma se preocupa cuando encuentra una carta de Roberta donde le dice que se irá por unos días, pero Roberta ha decidido irse de manera definitiva. Roberta se deprime al recordar su solitaria infancia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía contrata a un estilista para que le quite el pegamento que Sol le echó en el cabello. Diego le confiesa a Iñaki que pasó la noche con Roberta. Mía cobra venganza y le juega una broma pesada a Sol.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual trata de arruinar el concierto de RBD en beneficio de los niños de la calle. Roberta se las ingenia para dejar la escuela incomunicada y estropear las intenciones de Pascual. Roberta no quiere contarle a su mamá que Diego la secuestró.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta es descubierta en la dirección por Pascual. Jose descubre que Roberta le escribió a su tutor. Alma no está segura quien es el padre de Roberta. Roberta discute con Luján porque quiere dejar el colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no quiere irse a París con su papá, pues no quiere dejar a Miguel y a la banda. Miguel trata de convencer a Mía de viajar con su padre. El padre de Mía habla con Pascual para que Alma deje de darle clases a su hija.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Licha interroga a Adolfo y por fin se entera de dónde viene el novio de La Nena. Mientras tanto Martina hace una obra de caridad, convirtiendo a Tecla en una chica agradable.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Esteban Arce contacta a Plácido para que concurse por una enorme casa libre de impuestos. Los López tendrán que contestar a cinco preguntas, sin embargo, como en la última se tardan, pierden el premio. Aun así, reciben una sorpresa.

programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.desc: Licha interroga a Adolfo y por fin se entera de dónde viene el novio de La Nena. Mientras tanto Martina hace una obra de caridad, convirtiendo a Tecla en una chica agradable.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Esteban Arce contacta a Plácido para que concurse por una enorme casa libre de impuestos. Los López tendrán que contestar a cinco preguntas, sin embargo, como en la última se tardan, pierden el premio. Aun así, reciben una sorpresa.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López es notificada de que se les cortará el servicio del agua en su departamento. Los miembros de la familia intentan averiguar quién es el responsable de que les hayan retirado el servicio del agua.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido expresa ante su familia su sentir acerca de la falta de intimidad que existe en su hogar. La nueva dinámica para poder vivir en casa de los López es aportar dinero, de lo contrario deben tomar su turno para poder residir ahí.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Adolfo y que fueron tres veces.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido se preocupa por una llamada de Don Justo y le expresa a su familia que tendrá una reunión con su jefe. Don Justo va a nombrar socio a quien le tenga su café caliente.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Se va la luz en el apartamento de la familia López y comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas. Tecla es confundida con un fantasma. Don Arnoldo se da cuenta de que, mientras se fue la luz, han desaparecido sus tamales.

programme.title: Una familia de diez

programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

programme.title: Bent
programme.desc: A discredited former cop connects a murder case to an elaborate conspiracy involving high-stakes treason.

programme.title: Raw Deal
programme.desc: When efforts to prosecute mob boss Luigi Patrovita are repeatedly derailed thanks to a mole in the FBI, the only choice is to bring in an outsider -- specifically, Mark Kaminsky, a disgraced agent who leaps at a chance for reinstatement. After FBI chief Shannon gives him his orders, Kaminsky fakes his death and reemerges as an ex-con named Brenner. Undercover and accountable to no one, the former Fed tears up the mob from the inside.

programme.title: Manhunter
programme.desc: FBI criminal profiler Will Graham (William Petersen) is called out of early retirement to assist on a serial murder case involving a killer known as the "Tooth Fairy" (Tom Noonan). Graham enlists the help of imprisoned serial killer -- and cannibal -- Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Brian Cox), who is the reason Graham took an early retirement. Soon, Graham and the FBI are entangled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game between the Tooth Fairy, Lecter and an interfering journalist (Stephen Lang).

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant
programme.desc: The Lieutenant (Harvey Keitel) is a corrupt cop steeped in gambling debt who exploits his authority to sexually harass teenage girls, embezzle money and abuse drugs. His troubles come to a head when a mob lackey delivers an ultimatum: pay off his debt, or else. His fate appears sealed. But when The Lieutenant learns that a $50,000 reward is being offered to whoever catches a pair of thugs who raped a nun (Frankie Thorn), he jumps at the opportunity, hoping that he can still redeem himself.

programme.title: Light Sleeper
programme.desc: A Manhattan drug dealer with a wealthy clientele, John LeTour reevaluates both his trade and his life after discovering that his supplier, Ann, is planning on quitting the business. When John runs into his old flame Marianne, he sees reconnecting with her as a way to change for the better, but she is reluctant to rekindle the romance. Complicating John's life further is a series of drug-related murders that has the police pegging him as a suspect.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: Steve Harvey assumes the hosting duties for this daytime game show in which five members of one family are pitted against five members of another family. Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.desc: A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing, abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts, steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors.

programme.title: SiREN
programme.desc: One week before his wedding day, Jonah and his groomsmen hit the town for a wild night of club hopping and debauchery. The night soon takes a twisted turn for the worse when the group is invited to a seedy underground club. After Jonah frees a seemingly imprisoned dancer, he realizes that the woman he released is actually a terrifying, legendary creature that will stop at nothing to claim her prey.

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

When her parents miraculously return, they try to settle back into normal life, but become increasingly concerned about something that has affected their daughter Stephanie.

When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules

The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators' arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land.

programme.title: Snowpiercer

The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Boy Kills World
programme.desc: Boy is a mayhem machine who's been training to assassinate the bloodthirsty Hilda Van Der Koy and avenge his family's murder; guided by his sister's mischievous spirit, Boy uncovers one stunning revelation after another as he barrels toward Hilda.

programme.title: Crank
programme.desc: Chev Chelios (Jason Statham), a hit man wanting to go straight, lets his latest target slip away, then he awakes the next morning to a phone call that informs him he has been poisoned and has only an hour to live unless he keeps adrenaline coursing through his body while he searches for an antidote.

programme.title: Crank: High Voltage
programme.desc: After surviving an incredible plunge to near-certain death, Chev Chelios is abducted by Chinese mobsters. Waking up three months later, Chev finds that his nearly indestructible heart has been replaced with a battery-operated device that requires regular jolts of electricity, or it will fail. Chev escapes from his captors, reunites with his lover, Eve, and sets out on a frantic chase through Los Angeles to get his real heart back.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.title: Red 2
programme.desc: Former CIA black-ops agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) and his old partner, Marvin Boggs (John Malkovich), are caught in the grip of retirement -- but that soon changes when a powerful Cold War weapon known as Nightshade resurfaces decades after its disappearance. With assassins hot on their trail, Frank and his team set out to find the one scientist (Anthony Hopkins) who can unravel the mystery of Nightshade and help them save themselves -- and the world.

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: Though he once spent time in San Quentin, 22-year-old black man Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) is now trying hard to live a clean life and support his girlfriend (Melonie Diaz) and young daughter (Ariana Neal). Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
programme.desc: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

programme.title: El mexicano
programme.desc: Jacinto, un peleador que vence a todos sus rivales en Estados Unidos, ayuda a su hermano que es atacado por unos irlandeses. El antiguo rival de Jacinto mata a su esposa, por lo que Jacinto busca vengarse.

programme.title: Escuadrón salvaje
programme.desc: Los juegos de guerra se tornan mortales para un grupo de jóvenes, cuya alegre excursión culmina en una casa abandonada.

programme.title: Juan Nadie
programme.desc: Juan Nadie es un pistolero al que contratan para matar a un cacique. Juan lo hace y la viuda de este pone precio a su cabeza. Su mala fama lo lleva a ser perseguido por una banda.

programme.title: El Triángulo del Crimen
programme.desc: Un hombre sale de la cárcel, busca la ayuda de un viejo amigo y comprende que entre ellos aún existe la rivalidad que inició durante su infancia.

programme.title: Asesino del Metro
programme.desc: El miedo se impone sobre la Ciudad de México, cuando un asesino a sus víctimas, todas mujeres, en el metro de la ciudad.

programme.title: Por el Poder de la Mara
programme.desc: Un grupo de mafiosos desata una guerra cuando la esposa de un personaje clave para su organización es secuestrada.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: El caudillo
programme.desc: Un valiente revolucionario es buscado por las tropas federales, pero el pueblo lo ayuda a esconderse y luego a escapar.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: La Chamuscada
programme.desc: Un peón se une a la revolución y llega a ser coronel de las tropas zapatistas después de huir del maltrato de su patrón.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Renuncia por motivos de salud
programme.desc: Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.

programme.title: La trenza
programme.desc: Un pueblo confundido por la religión, persigue a una mujer que robó la trenza de la estatua de la Virgen.

programme.title: El hombre del puente
programme.desc: La odisea del expresidiario de un país dictatorial que queda inmovilizado por falta de papeles en un puente fronterizo.

programme.title: El extensionista
programme.desc: Un ingeniero va a enseñar a los campesinos a mejorar sus cultivos y descubre la gran opresión del cacique del pueblo.

programme.title: El Pichichi del Barrio
programme.desc: El Pichichi es el entrenador de un equipo de fútbol femenino patrocinado por un narcotraficante ambicioso.

programme.title: Cuentos colorados
programme.desc: Las aventuras ocurren en una casa de citas muy lujosa, pero el dueño no lo confiesa su profesión a su tía.

programme.title: El Triángulo del Crimen
programme.desc: Un hombre sale de la cárcel, busca la ayuda de un viejo amigo y comprende que entre ellos aún existe la rivalidad que inició durante su infancia.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo
programme.desc: Un espíritu vengativo se apodera de una joven suicida en un centro de tratamientos. Sucesos misteriosos del pasado atormentan el presente.
