programme.title: Big Tech Is Destroying Democracy
programme.desc: Baroness Beeban Kidron, filmmaker and tech campaigner, discusses her book Users: How Big Tech Took Control and How to Fight Back. She breaks down how big tech companies have influenced democracy, warped regulatory structures for their own benefit, and knowingly harmed their users.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Keir Starmer's Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump's Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz
programme.desc: 10 people go head to head in a movie quiz to see who will be the last one standing. If they get one question wrong they have to sit. If they get a second question wrong they have to kneel. And if they get a third question wrong, they are eliminated. 10 contestants compete for one cash prize.

programme.title: The Geography Elimination Quiz
programme.desc: 10 contestants face a series of geography trivia questions with elimination on the line. Get an answer wrong and you're out. Survive every round and take home the cash. Play along and see how long you last before the questions catch you out.

programme.title: Joe Pub Quiz with Eddie Hall & Expressions
programme.desc: Eddie Hall and Expressions take on a quiz about the Sidemen, Gen Z slang, old-school phrases, and iconic Sidemen quotes. From completely missing the mark to unexpectedly clutch answers, the episode is full of laughs as they attempt to decode Gen Z slang, test how well they know each other, and recall legendary Sidemen moments.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Hugh Jackman Takes On The Irish Test
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman steps up to the ultimate Irish test, trying his hand at making a proper Irish breakfast with mixed results, sharing thoughts on Ryan Reynolds, and tackling classic Irish challenges. Expect plenty of laughs and chaos as Hugh takes on various Irish cultural tasks.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Wonderful Wetlands
programme.desc: Water is the key to life. It provides a haven for countless plants and animals, everything from water-loving cats and predatory birds to killer dragonflies and carnivorous foliage. It can be a nursery, a migration stopover and a larder. And there's place where water is gathered, drained and stored for all to enjoy – the wetland. Wetlands are some of the most remarkable ecosystems in the natural world everything from dragonflies and bats to fish and amphibians can thrive thanks to the wonderful wetland.

programme.title: Extinction! Going, Going, Gone
programme.desc: Extinction, a daunting and confusing word. A force of nature, that sees the end of species, but also heralds the birth of others. Right now the extinction rate could be as much as 10,000 times faster than it should be. 20% of fish, a fifth of all reptiles and a quarter of mammals face extinction. If we are to do anything to stem the tide of extinction we must understand the lifestyles of those in danger. The future for countless animals is uncertain, but one thing is for sure – we have a lot to learn.

programme.title: Colours of Nature
programme.desc: From subtle to shocking, colour enhances the beauty of the natural world. Colour is a language to most living things, whether as a warning, camouflage or a come on. But there's more to colour than just pigment. Colours define how many animals behave, how they mate and how they inter-act with one another. For us the beautiful and varied shades of the animal kingdom form a spec-tacular kaleidoscope of colours. programme.title: Europe's Wild River
programme.sub-title: The Elbe - 1.000 Miles of Wildlife and Nature
programme.desc: The river rises in the Czech Giant Mountains. Here it is called the Labe. After Děčín it flows into Germany and is called Elbe. There are various explanations for the origin of the river name "Elbe". One often mentioned is the Latin name of the river "albia", which means "bright water". This would also explain why the stream is referred to with the feminine article "the Elbe", since the Latin term "albia" is also feminine. Rather poetic than linguistically probable, however, is the explanation that elves (Middle High German: alb) scurrying around the pines in the white river mists could have helped the river to get its name. Geographically, the river can be divided into different sections: The Upper Elbe is the part from the source to about Riesa in the administrative district of Dresden, which is more characterized by mountains. The Middle Elbe, on the other hand, is a lowland river. It reaches as far as the Geesthacht dam just outside Hamburg. The Lower Elbe is called the tidal part of the river. Here, the Elbe forms an estuary, a so-called estuary. At high tide, seawater enters this funnel-shaped delta at the mouth of the Elbe and mixes with the freshwater of the river. At low tide, the water then flows off to the North Sea. Finally, the continuation of the estuary funnel in the Wadden Sea is called the Outer Elbe.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature's best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. programme.title: Between Estonia and Finland
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest ocean in the world and first evolved after the last Ice Age. We think we know everything about it, yet still it has many surprises in store. Wind and waves still shape the shores of the Baltic Sea. The second episode presents a world comprising tens of thousands of islands, between Estonia, Gotland in Sweden and the Finnish Archipelago Sea. In the Autumn on Saaremaa, the largest Estonian island, nasal sounds can be heard from one corner to the next: The mating calls of the Moose. Huge bulls make their way to the traditional rutting areas in the south of the island. The landscape here is stony and riddled with countless bays. In the north, the Panga Cliff, a limestone wall of some 20 metres in height and more than 400 million years old. In the beginning of March, animal filmmaker Christoph Hauschild and his team accompany two seal researchers going about their work. Their destinations are two small islands in the Bay of Riga. A popular spot for grey seals. This is the first time that a film team has been allowed on the island. Just how many animals there are, can first be seen from the air. The beach is packed with young seals. The largest gathering in the Baltic Sea. The absence of pack ice forces the mothers to come here. Global warming has visibly changed the Baltic Sea as far as the Bay of Riga. The winters are simply too hot for the well-insulated young seals. So as not to overheat, they take dips in the cooling water. The underwater camera captures intimate moments and reveals just how playfully the youngsters enjoy the cool water. Just 200 kilometres to the west lies an ancient coral reef, Gotland. The Swedish island is like an ark in the central Baltic Sea. Much of the flora and fauna one otherwise only finds in Southern Europe can be found here on the second largest island in the Baltic Sea. Golden eagles breed here in the trees and in the spring, the ground is covered in orchids. 35 different varieties grow on Gotland.

programme.title: The Red Desert

programme.title: Wild Sex
programme.desc: Sex is at the heart of everything. It's the only real way of leaving a legacy - in the genes of the future. But there's more than just the act - it's the build up to it when wildlife shows its incredible diversity. It drives touching courtships and fierce battles. Hormones and sex drive are forces that shape behaviour and can change an animal's purpose and persona. This is the story of how wild things get sexy. Without sex, there's nothing. It's a driving force throughout nature. The act of sex is mostly to make babies, but let's face it, its foreplay that really counts - it brings out the best and the worst in the animal kingdom. Pre-coital courtship can give pleasure, but also gives the participants the chance to check each other out and make sure they've found the perfect match. It affects us all. Birds do it, bees do it, all the way through the animals kingdom. From fire flies who mix up their own chemistry sets to fill the forest with mood lighting, to mayflies that emerge on mass, by the millions to mate. Their vast orgies attract predators of all sizes. Fish risk their lives climbing rivers from the sea, and a barrage of bears and other predators - just for sex - but the mission is so strenuous it kills them, as soon as their eggs are laid, they wither and die. Sex and the hormones that drive it can turn cute and cuddly into a sex beast. It turns out the koala is a sex maniac, more into rape than romance. Many mammals, from guanaco (wild llama) to hippos chase, wrestle and bite their way to a romantic interlude. Huge male red Kangaroos even box. When it comes to wild sex, mammals are amazing, but its birds that are the real show stoppers. From dazzling peacocks to booming bustards, fighting turkeys to dancing birds of paradise, birds go all out on foreplay - though you sometimes have to wonder if it's worth it - after all that parading their sex is over in seconds There's a lot of effort for very little reward.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: It's a dream route leading from the casino metropolis of Las Vegas, to Salt Lake City, the Mormon capital. It is a journey that follows the footsteps of the first settlers: the Mormons. They came to this desert belt of the United States during the second half of the 19th century to escape persecution and in search of the promised land. Some of them founded Las Vegas. Others moved through the canyons and over the mountains of the colossal Colorado Plateau, where they found water and pasture, to establish many small settlements. The landscapes through which they trekked, had and still have, a breathtaking and bizarre majestic beauty. Bryce Canyon, the hogbacks and the Escalante Staircase plateau are dramatic scenes of wonder formed from rock. The Pajute Indians once described Bryce Canyon as: “red rocks standing like men in a basin”.

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: The Bigger Picture

programme.title: Beasts And Dragons, Rise Of Garmadon
programme.desc: Zane, Jay, and Kai remember some of Ninjago's fearsome creatures so that Cole defend the cave from an unidentified monster. But Ninja confront memories of their greatest villain and ally, Garmadon, before the threat to Zane controls him completely.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: Getting Tthe Message
programme.desc: twisted than a funhouse mirror? A text gone wrong! The frantic race against time when Emma discovers that her brute and worse - the boys locker room!innocent text to Mia was sent to Matthew by mistake -- a Friends' fun day at Heartlake Amusement Park turns into a they need to brave space rides, dunking booths, an angry As the Friends enjoy Heartlake Amusement Park, Emma types a text to Mia, but sends it to Matthew by mistake a text that could be mega-embarrassing for Emma! As her BFF's, the Friends race to find Matthew's phone and erase the text before he reads it. But first, they must brave space rides, dunking booths and worse: the boys locker room! What's more frightening than a roller coaster? More BFF's, the Friends must scramble to retrieve Matthew's text that accidentally sounds like a pledge of Emma's undying love for Matthew! Mega-embarrassing! As Emma's phone and erase the text before he reads it. But first,

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis- We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder? While our handwriting may not reveal the nuances of our personalities, the dotting of the 'i's and crossing of the 't's is an important business in criminal investigation. Apparent suicide notes, letters from suspected offenders and signatures are scrutinized down to the last dot. Handwriting comparisons can tell if the victim really did sign that new life insurance policy, or if the person who had everything to live for actually wrote the eloquent suicide note.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown
programme.desc: An unassuming male nurse from Kentucky comes under scrutiny when hospital officials notice that death is unusually prominent during his work shifts. In fact, death seemed to follow Donald Harvey from job to job, beginning in 1970 and ending with his arrest in 1987. Harvey – probably the most prolific serial murderer in the nation's history – claimed to have murdered his ailing charges out of compassion, but his meticulous diary, 30 pounds of cyanide, and a witch's brew of dangerous drugs discovered in his home pointed to darker motives. And his quiet rampage would have likely continued, if not for the vigilant coroner who decided to investigate further the odd smell of almonds coming from his fresh corpse.

Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.22
programme.desc: When King Seonjo selects Yukdo's lid, Yukdo struggles to contain his joy, while Jeongi graciously acknowledges his skill. Gwanghae petitions the king to lift the Chief Scholar's exile, but Seonjo misinterprets the request as a threat to royal authority. Seizing the moment, Inbin plots to frame Gwanghae for treason by forging his letter. As Jeongi departs on Gangcheon's errand to mine white clay, Gwanghae mounts his horse and races after her.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.23
programme.desc: Upon returning to the palace, Gwanghae insists that the letter King Seonjo presents to him has been forged—but the king refuses to believe it. Jeongi is shaken when Imhae warns her that anyone tied to the alleged treason will not escape unscathed. When Jeongi meets Gwanghae, she vows to restrain even her own feelings so as not to become a burden to him. Court Lady Gukbi is stunned to learn that Jeongi is Yeonok's daughter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.24
programme.desc: After uncovering the full truth, Jeongi begins searching for a way to bring about Gangcheon's downfall, with Taedo pledging to help her. When Jeongi and Gwanghae cross paths at the Bunwon, they share a tender, wordless gaze filled with longing. Upon discovering a ledger detailing Gangcheon's bribes, Jeongi resolves to win Royal Consort Inbin's favor. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong decides to eliminate Son Haengsu.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.25
programme.desc: Leaving her audience with Inbin, Jeongi runs into Gangcheon and Yukdo at the palace. When King Seonjo refers to Euldam as a traitor, Jeongi is left on edge. Together with Taedo, she devises a plan to ensnare Gangcheon. Later, Gwanghae returns the bowl Jeongi once gave to Son Haengsu. Impressed by Jeongi's skill, Inbin requests that if Jeongi crafts a medicine bowl that fully satisfies Prince Shinseong, she be officially appointed a master potter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.26
programme.desc: As Jeongi and Yukdo face off in a decisive competition, all eyes at the Bunwon are fixed on the outcome. Thrilled at the prospect of becoming nangcheong, Yukdo is confident of victory. Jeongi asks Hwa-ryeong to procure the white clay needed for the contest, while Hwa-ryeong urges Yukdo to defeat Jeongi at all costs. When the medicine bowls are completed, Jeongi and Yukdo anxiously await Prince Shinseong's judgment—until the prince suddenly collapses after drinking from the bowl.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.27
programme.desc: Jeongi confronts Gangcheon, demanding that he reveal the truth about Euldam, but his shameless willingness to offer a false confession only fuels her anger. Gwanghae vows before King Seonjo to uncover not only the truth behind the current 사건 but also the events of the previous nangcheong competition. A royal order is issued for Yukdo's execution, and a grief-stricken Gangcheon kneels before the palace gates in penitence.

programme.sub-title: The Science of Crime - Bud Detectives
programme.desc: In most Western countries, they solve more than 90% of serious crimes. This high success rate is largely thanks to forensic experts. These pros, skilled in different branches of forensics, aid the police and the legal system in cracking cases. For example, entomologists, who study insects, play a part by examining flies, maggots, and beetles found on a body to help pinpoint the time of death, which is often a crucial clue for investigators.

programme.title: Forensics
programme.sub-title: The Science of Crime - Genetic Fingerprinting
programme.desc: In the lab, crime scene investigator Dr. Harald Schneider works on extracting DNA from tiny samples. Just 0.5 square millimeters is enough to identify a unique genetic profile. Initially, you could only determine whose DNA it was, but now the techniques have improved. Nowadays, you can predict things like eye, hair, and skin color from a DNA sample. Is this what the future holds? Will we soon see genetic ID pictures?

programme.title: Forensics
programme.sub-title: The Science of Crime - Blood Secrets
programme.desc: A weapon is discovered at a crime scene. The big question for the investigators: Did this weapon shoot the victim? Molecular ballistics can really help clear things up. When a person is shot, organic material from them can get blasted back into the weapon. Scientists like Cornelius Courts check out these traces. He can figure out not just who was shot with the gun but also where they were hit.

programme.title: Myths: The Greatest Mysteries of Humanity

There's a tale that Attila lies beneath a river. Meanwhile, rock star Levente Szörényi believes his grave is in an old quarry. programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

Belle lavora sodo: la magione è stupenda, il cliente un po' meno. Quando, però, i due cominciano a spendere più tempo assieme scocca la scintilla. Basterà questo a scaldare il suo cuore di ghiaccio?

Grazie a Gennarino, uno scugnizzo orfano del quale è diventato amico e protettore, Don Salvatore riesce a smascherare gli assassini del figlio, ma si mette nei guai.

Mario, dovendo dimostrare di essere in grado di provvedere con larghezza al figlio, in pratica si trova costretto a diventare un criminale. Quando finisce in galera, Daniela provvede al figlio senza però rivelargli di essere sua madre. La donna continua a comportarsi male nei confronti di Mario e si riavvicinerà a lui solo quando Sal avrà un grave incidente con il motorino.

programme.title: L'Ave Maria
programme.desc: Un giovane cantante vede finalmente avvicinarsi il successo, ma la carriera rischia di allontanarlo dal figlio e dalla donna che potrebbe ridare equilibrio alla sua vita.

programme.title: Totò Story
programme.desc: Un omaggio a Totò costruito attraverso celebri sequenze dei suoi film. Gag, personaggi e momenti indimenticabili ripercorrono la carriera e la comicità del Principe della risata.

programme.title: Bravissimo
programme.desc: Il maestro Ubaldo Impallato insegna in un doposcuola di periferia e scopre in uno dei suoi allievi una voce da baritono fuori dal comune. Convinto di aver trovato un talento destinato al successo, prova a trasformare il ragazzo in una star, tra impresari, illusioni e inevitabili complicazioni.

programme.title: Intrigo a Taormina
programme.desc: Durante una crociera di lusso verso la Sicilia, gli ospiti del commendator Lemeni intrecciano relazioni, gelosie e tradimenti. Coppie e amanti si scambiano in una catena di equivoci sentimentali tra mare e mondanità.

programme.title: Costa azzurra
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi e Giovanna Ralli in una divertentissima commedia. Due coniugi romani arrivano in Costa Azzurra perché la moglie spera di sfondare nel cinema nonostante le perplessità del marito. Quando però il regista propone una parte proprio al marito, anziché alla moglie, è proprio l'uomo che inizia ad illudersi.

programme.title: Le belle famiglie
programme.desc: Quattro episodi osservano famiglie ricche e povere nell'Italia degli anni Sessanta. Dietro rispettabilità, aspirazioni e convenzioni emergono egoismi, contraddizioni e assurdità della vita domestica.

programme.title: C'era una volta
programme.desc: Napoli, XVII secolo. Il principe Rodrigo Ferrantte y Davalos, nobile spagnolo di grande fascino e coraggio, è in Italia. Deve trovare una sposa e la corte gli impone la scelta tra sette belle principesse. Ma lui s`innamora di una paesana, semplice, fiera e sanguigna, di rara bellezza e di incredibili virtù, di nome Isabella. Il loro amore, fulmineo e improvviso, incontrerà molti ostacoli...

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: Splendor
programme.desc: Il proprietario, il proiezionista e la maschera di una sala di provincia che sta per chiudere i battenti si abbandonano ai ricordi: ma quando gli operai stanno già schiodando le poltrone...

programme.title: Cacciatore di teste
programme.desc: Bruno Davert è un manager del settore della carta di mezza età che ha perso il lavoro a causa di una ristrutturazione e delocalizzazione della sua azienda. Convinto di trovare immediatamente un altro lavoro all'altezza del suo curriculum, dopo oltre due anni di ricerche si ritrova ancora disoccupato. Decide così di mettere in atto un piano destinato a restituirgli il lavoro presso la principale azienda del settore, la Arcadia. Il piano consiste nell'eliminazione fisica di tutti i suoi principali concorrenti, altri manager che come lui hanno perso il posto e vivono di espedienti partecipando ad umilianti colloqui di lavoro.

programme.title: Rabbit Hole
programme.desc: Rabbit Hole è un adattamento dell'omonima pièce teatrale di David Lindsay-Abaire, vincitrice del Premio Pulitzer nel 2007. La storia ruota intorno a Becca (Nicole Kidman) ed Howie (Aaron Eckhart) una coppia newyorkese che ha perso il figlio di 4 anni in un incidente stradale. Le cose si complicano ulteriormente quando Becca si mette sulle tracce del giovane ragazzo che ha provocato l'incidente…La regia è firmata da John Cameron Mitchell autore del controverso “Shortbus” mentre della sceneggiatura si è occupato lo stesso Lindsay-Abaire. Nel cast figurano anche Tammy Blanchard, Dianne Wiest e Sandra Oh.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: Il fotografo ventiseienne Dennis Stock è molto più maturo dei suoi anni e ancora legato alla vita familiare quando nel 1955 riceve il compito di fotografare per il magazine Life l'astro nascente James Dean, uno spirito libero destinato a divenire un idolo e a cambiare per sempre la cultura popolare. L'assegnazione del servizio porterà Dennis e James ad affrontare un viaggio per gli States, che plasmerà Stock e consegnerà alla storia alcune delle immagini più iconiche del periodo.

programme.title: Prima danza e poi pensa
programme.desc: Il film ci mostra le tappe fondamentali della vita del grande scrittore Samuel Beckett, dall'infanzia in Irlanda al periodo parigino.

programme.title: Un Orso Di Nome Winnie
programme.desc: Le origini di Winnie the Pooh. La storia vera di Harry Colebourn, un soldato canadese che, ai tempi della Primo conflitto mondiale, comprò un cucciolo di orso rimasto orfano, lo addomesticò e gli diede il nome della sua città natale: Winnipeg.

programme.title: Se mi amate
programme.desc: Un medico si innamora della figlia di un paziente milionario in coma. Nonostante sia arrivato il momento di staccare la spina, il dottore deve combattere contro avvocati senza scrupoli che vogliono tenere l'uomo in vita, nell'interesse dell'ospedale.

programme.title: Fuga Da Pretoria
programme.desc: Arrestati per aver partecipato ad operazioni segrete per conto dell'African National Congress di Nelson Mandela, due attivisti sudafricani cercano di inviare un messaggio al regime dell'apartheid e fuggire dalla famigerata prigione di Pretoria.

programme.title: Souvenir d'italie
programme.desc: La storia di tre turiste straniere: l'inglese Margaret, la francese Josette e la tedesca Hilde che passano la frontiera con l'Italia per visitare il nostro Paese ma un incidente alla loro macchina le costringerà ad arrangiarsi con mezzi di fortuna.

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: Violet, sedici anni, sogna di fare la cantante e vive sola con sua madre che ha difficoltà ad arrivare a fine mese. Quando scopre che sono aperte le audizioni per il talent show Teen Spirit, partecipa nella speranza che sia il punto di partenza per la sua carriera di cantante.

programme.title: I segni del cuore
programme.desc: Ruby non è una liceale qualunque: le sue giornate iniziano su una barca da pesca, a fianco di suo fratello Leo, papà Frank e mamma Jackie, che sono tutti sordi. Ma la sua più grande passione è il canto e di talento ne ha da vendere.

programme.title: Please Stand By: Tutto ciò che voglio
programme.desc: Wendy soffre di una forma di autismo, che la cura e la struttura specializzata di Scottie riescono a tenere sotto controllo, favorendo una rigida routine quotidiana e permettendo che la ragazza coltivi la sua passione, ovvero la visione della saga televisiva di Star Trek.

programme.title: L'eroe
programme.desc: Un giornalista ambizioso ma mediocre viene relegato a una redazione di provincia e poi licenziato. Quando il nipote di una potente imprenditrice viene rapito, torna al centro della scena. Tra scoop e paure collettive, il paese cerca un colpevole.

programme.title: The Dark
programme.desc: Un mattatoio di Welch è lo scenario di una serie di eventi misteriosi che colpiscono una giovane famiglia perseguitata dal fantasma arrabbiato di un bambino morto proprio lì anni prima.
Un uomo che sta scrivendo un libro sul paranormale, si reca a New York e soggiorna in una stanza d'albergo che si dice sia responsabile della morte di tutti gli ospiti che vi soggiornano.

programme.title: Halloween The Beginning
programme.desc: Il feroce assassino Michael Meyers viene rilasciato dall'istituto psichiatrico in cui è stato rinchiuso per 17 anni e si scatena alla ricerca della sorella minore. Questo significa solo una cosa: nessuno è al sicuro!

programme.title: Nottetempo
programme.desc: Un incidente, tre vite spezzate, un viaggio tra verità nascoste e incontri inaspettati. Un noir sentimentale che scava nell'anima.

programme.title: Grace is Gone
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo porta le figlie in viaggio prima di dir loro la verità

programme.title: Nove cuccioli sotto l'albero
programme.desc: Due amanti dei gatti si ritrovano a Natale quando devono trovare una casa a nove adorabili gattini, riscoprendo anche il sentimento che li aveva uniti.

programme.title: Innamorarsi a Natale
programme.desc: Due rivali in affari, inconsapevolmente attratti l'uno dall'altra dietro identità anonime, vengono costretti a collaborare a un'app natalizia e scoprono sentimenti inattesi.

programme.title: Innamorarsi sul ghiaccio
programme.desc: Un giocatore professionista di hockey e una libraia vengono costretti a lavorare insieme per migliorare la propria immagine pubblica e finiscono per scoprire quanto gli opposti possano attrarsi.

programme.title: Natale con i tuoi
programme.desc: Una famiglia trascorre le feste con parenti eccentrici e, dopo aver dimenticato i regali a casa, padre e figlio affrontano un rocambolesco viaggio notturno per salvarne il Natale.

programme.title: 12 sfide di Natale
programme.desc: Un'insegnante accetta una sfida natalizia composta da dodici prove mentre prepara la sua città per un programma di scambio, ritrovandosi sempre più vicina a un affascinante collega.

programme.title: Dolcezze d'autunno
programme.desc: Maggie, imprenditrice di successo, torna a casa per la lettura del testamento e scopre di aver ereditato metà della famosa azienda di caramelle all'acero della zia. Quello che non capisce è perché Dex, il fornitore di aceri della zia Dee, abbia ereditato l'altra metà. Il suo ritorno coincide anche con il Sweet Autumn Fest che si tiene in città. Grazie ad una serie di lettere lasciate da zia Dee, Maggie e Dex cercano di scoprire il motivo delle ultime volontà della zia. Mentre lei e Dex si avvicinano, Maggie deve decidere se la vita che ha costruito è davvero quella che vuole.

programme.title: Ritardare
programme.desc: Proprio mentre la sua vita sta andando a rotoli, una giovane donna vive una terribile tragedia quando il suo ragazzo viene assassinato da un intruso dal quale la donna stessa riesce a malapena a fuggire.

programme.title: Uno studente da incubo
programme.desc: Brianna è ferita quando scopre che il suo fidanzato Nick la tradisce con la sua collega Christina, così Brianna si confida con uno sconosciuto online, ma ben presto la sua vita si sgretola quando si rende conto che non è uno sconosciuto.

programme.title: La famiglia perfetta
programme.desc: La madre single Karen assume Alex come manny senza sapere che lui diventa ossessivamente legato a loro e cerca di prendere il controllo della vita della sua famiglia.

programme.title: Destinazione Matrimonio
programme.desc: Due perfetti sconosciuti si incontrano a un matrimonio in un'isola tropicale: lei è la testimone della sposa, lui il miglior amico dello sposo. Tra brindisi, gaffe e balli sotto le stelle, la loro iniziale antipatia si trasforma lentamente in qualcosa di più…

programme.title: L'amore sa dove trovarti
programme.desc: Emma, giovane Amish con il cuore pieno dei romanzi di Jane Austen, sogna una vita oltre i confini della sua comunità. Durante un'estate in Ohio, si ritrova sospesa tra due mondi e due amori: Noah, fedele alle radici, e Andy, un giornalista che le offre la libertà.

programme.title: Dangerous Beauty
programme.desc: Alla fine del 1500, come amanti degli uomini importanti di Venezia, le donne avevano uno stile di vita regale ed erano incoraggiate a leggere e a studiare in un periodo in cui l'istruzione era proibita per la maggior parte delle donne.

programme.title: Cruise
programme.desc: Estate 1987. Gio, un ragazzo italiano del Queens, pensa solamente alle automobili e alle ragazze. Crede di aver capito tutto fino a quando non incontra Jessica, una graziosa ragazza ebrea di Long Island a cui piace provare emozioni proibite.

programme.title: Qui dove batte il cuore
programme.desc: Una diciassettenne incinta ricostruisce la propria vita dopo essere stata abbandonata dal suo ragazzo in un Walmart a Sequoyah, in Oklahoma.

programme.title: November Criminals
programme.desc: Il liceale Addison Schacht vende droga ai suoi compagni di classe, ha un rapporto turbolento con la sua migliore amica, e si improvvisa investigatore sfidando le autorità per scoprire la verità.

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: Vienna, seconda metà dell'Ottocento. L' acclamato illusionista Eisenheim incanta le platee con i suoi incredibili trucchi. Ha persino catturato l' interesse del Principe Leopoldo e della sua fidanzata Sophia, un tempo legata sentimentalmente allo stesso Eisenheim.

programme.title: L'odore della notte
programme.desc: Remo Guerra è un poliziotto dalla doppia vita. Durante la notte è a capo di un gruppo di rapinatori dell'estrema periferia di Roma che commette diverse rapine nelle case dei ricchi.

programme.title: Mancino Naturale
programme.desc: Isabella è vedova da tre anni e vive in un modesto appartamento a Latina con Paolo, il figlio dodicenne, sul quale ha riversato tutte le sue aspettative.

programme.title: La lingua dellamore
programme.desc: Dottorato in Linguistica Julie può parlare quasi tutte le lingue. Le cose si capovolgono per Julie quando il bel Dan la contatta per prendere lezioni di francese. Volano presto scintille: potrebbe essere questo il loro abbinamento perfetto?

programme.title: Il disegno del Natale
programme.desc: Ember Morley, graphic designer e aspirante illustratrice di libri di fiabe a Manhattan, rimane sorpresa quando scopre di aver ereditato la fattoria degli alberi di Natale di sua nonna. Ritorna nella sua città natale, Willow Hill, per venderlo prima di Natale, ma gli affascinanti cittadini la convincono a restare un po' più a lungo e ad aiutarla a pianificare il loro annuale Festival dell'albero di Natale. Quando è costretta a lavorare con Brandon Hart, il bel custode della fattoria, Ember si ricorda delle cose che una volta desiderava nella vita. La magia del Natale la guiderà sulla strada giusta?

programme.title: La meta del cuore
programme.desc: Il suo sogno è sempre stato quello di organizzare eventi, ecco perché quando i suoi migliori amici decidono di sposarsi, Madison si offre di occuparsi lei di tutto.

programme.title: Un matrimonio su misura
programme.desc: Cassie, contabile e perfezionista, crede che la sua vita sia perfettamente sulla buona strada, almeno fino a quella di sua madre la wedding planner abbandona e torna nella sua città natale per organizzare l'evento.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: L'ultimo amore di Casanova
programme.desc: Figlio del XVIII secolo, avventuriero veneziano e amante del piacere, del gioco d'azzardo e dell'avventura: sono questi i tratti che caratterizzano Giacomo Casanova, che - in cerca di nuove emozioni - decide di recarsi a Londra, una città in cui non ha mai messo piede prima. L'unico posto che conosce è quello che gli è stato consigliato dal Cardinale de Bernis, un famoso ed elegante bordello gestito da un francese.

programme.title: The Girl in the Book
programme.desc: Alice Harvey, ventinovenne assistente editor e aspirante scrittrice, è divertente, intelligente ed emotivamente autodistruttiva. Scalando le fila di una importante casa editrice, si sforza di scrivere la propria storia da sempre ostacolata dai ricordi della sua relazione giovanile con Milan, il miglior amico di suo padre. Dopo 15 anni, i percorsi di Alice e Milan si incrociano ancora una volta, costringendo i due a confrontarsi con eventi che sono ormai lontani.

programme.title: Dalle 5 Alle 7
programme.desc: Un aspirante romanziere comincia una relazione con una donna, anche se c'è solo un problema: la donna è sposata e la coppia può incontrarsi solo tra le 5 e le 7 ogni sera.

programme.title: È arrivata mia figlia!
programme.desc: Val, governante devota, vede il suo equilibrio cambiare quando la figlia Jessica arriva con le sue ambizioni. Un film vincitore al Berlinale e al Sundance che esplora temi di classe e disuguaglianza, con un'interpretazione straordinaria di Regina Casé.

programme.title: The Farewell, Una Bugia Buona
programme.desc: Billi, nata in Cina e cresciuta negli USA, tornata a malincuore a Changchun, scopre che in famiglia tutti sanno che alla sua amata nonna restano solo poche settimane di vita, ma hanno deciso di tenere nascosta la verità alla diretta interessata.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: Spanglish
programme.sub-title: Quando In Famiglia Sono In Troppi A Parlare
programme.desc: Flor emigra a Los Angeles dal Messico sperando di migliorare la sua vita e quella di sua figlia Cristina. Assunta dalla famiglia Clasky come loro governante, Flor avrà a che fare con una lingua a lei del tutto sconosciuta, la femminilità nascente della figlia, e l'eccentrico modo di vivere della famiglia Clasky.

programme.title: Ace Ventura
programme.desc: È il migliore che c'è. Anche perché è l'unico…Jim Carrey (The Mask, Scemo e più scemo, Bugiardo Bugiardo) è impegnato nel caso di scomparsa della mascotte dei Miami Dolphins, un delfino, e del quarterback Dan Marino. Nella ricerca si trova faccia a faccia con uno squalo mangiauomini, mette sotto sorveglianza i Miami Dolphins e corteggia con grande successo le donne. E in ogni caso, sotto mentite spoglie, sotto piogge di proiettili o sott'acqua, trova sempre ciò che sta cercando.

programme.title: Ace Ventura
programme.desc: Ace è in Africa per salvare un animale che proprio non sopporta - un pipistrello! Jim Carrey torna nei panni del pet detective. Se sei pronto a ridere come una iena, se hai voglia di divertirti davvero, sai cosa fare. Rispondi alla chiamata della giungla.

programme.title: Tutte le ex del mio ragazzo
programme.desc: Brittany Murphy catturerà il vostro cuore in questo divertentissimo film su una brava ragazza che non ne combina una giusta. Assunta per lavorare in un talk show televisivo, la vita di Stacy Holt è stravolta quando viene convinta ad esplorare uno dei temi del programma e controlla l'agenda del suo ragazzo. Ma si è dimenticata una cosa: nel mondo della TV, c'è sempre una sorpresa scioccante dietro l'angolo -- e lei ne avrà una bella grande!

programme.title: Il magnate
programme.desc: Clara, moglie di Furio Cicerone, rifiuta il conte Arienti, ma intrighi finanziari mettono tutto a rischio

programme.title: Le spie vengono dal semifreddo
programme.desc: Due portieri siciliani fermano il piano di Goldfoot per scatenare una guerra, ma finiscono prigionieri in Siberia

programme.title: Tutti a squola
programme.desc: Un professore all'antica finisce in galera per droga e guadagna popolarità tra gli studenti

programme.title: La pretora
programme.desc: Una pretora inflessibili affronta i ricatti dei rivali che usano la gemella pornostar, ma lei reagisce con fermezza

programme.title: Mi faccia causa
programme.desc: Davanti al pretore Giovanni Pennisi transita tutti i giorni un campionario di varia umanità,

programme.title: La donna più bella del mondo
programme.desc: Gina Lollobrigida interpreta una donna affascinante e ambiziosa che cerca di farsi strada nel mondo dello spettacolo. Tra amori e tradimenti, la sua bellezza diventa sia un vantaggio che una trappola, esplorando la superficialità e le difficoltà della fama.

programme.title: Il medico dei pazzi
programme.desc: Dalla commedia di Eduardo Scarpetta. Totò è il generoso zio di uno scapestrato nipote, che l'ha ingannato dicendo di essersi laureato e di dirigere una clinica psichiatrica (in realtà la clinica non esiste, è solo un mezzo per spillar quattrini). Totò un giorno arriva a Napoli per controllare la vita del nipotastro. Capita nella pensione di questi e prende i pensionanti per matti.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: Le avventure di un uomo invisibile
programme.desc: Un semplice pisolino e Nick Halloway, broker un po' esaurito, e' convinto di risvegliarsi come nuovo. Invece si risveglia come... sparito! Volatilizzato. Un incidente nucleare ha trasformato Nick nell'Uomo Invisibile.

programme.title: Boys
programme.desc: Joe, Carlo, Bobo e Giacomo sono i "Boys", una rock band che ha avuto un enorme (quanto fulmineo) successo negli anni Settanta. Oggi, nonostante abbiano preso strade diverse, il loro è ancora un legame di amicizia fraterna.

programme.title: Qualcosa di troppo
programme.desc: Con i protagonisti di “Non sposate le mie figlie” e “La famiglia Belier”.Jeanne è una madre single con alle spalle un divorzio e una discreta insofferenza verso gli uomini. Finché una mattina si risveglia con una sorpresa che le cambierà completamente la vita.

programme.title: Uncle Drew
programme.desc: Il giovane proprietario di una squadra e Uncle Drew (L'All-Star NBA Kyrie Irving) riuniscono la vecchia squadra di Drew per dimostrare che un gruppo di settuagenari può ancora vincere un grande torneo.

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Uno Anzi Due
programme.desc: Da quando suo padre è morto, Maurizio è sommerso dai debiti ma decide di nascondere tutto alla moglie e al figlio che sta per sposarsi. Un mare di debiti, bugie e malintesi nella commedia esilarante con Maurizio Battista e Claudia Pandolfi.

programme.title: Gatto nero, gatto bianco
programme.desc: Due giovani si vogliono bene, ma le loro famiglie si oppongono. È solo il pretesto per tutto il resto di questo film unico. Il Kusturica più vero, e Leone d'Argento a Venezia

programme.title: Love shooting
programme.desc: Charlie è un produttore cinematografico che si lascia convincere a realizzare un film su Benjamin Disraeli, a patto che il protagonista sia un attore di grande fama che però verrà rapito, costringendo Charlie ad escogitare una soluzione creativa.

programme.title: James Tont Operazione D.U.E.
programme.desc: Un pericoloso gruppo criminale vuole distruggere la basilica di San Pietro seguendo un piano chiamato Operazione DUE, Distruzione Urbe Eterna. L'unico che può fermarli è l'agente segreto James Tont. Con il mitico Lando Buzzanca.

programme.title: Genoveffa di Brabante
programme.desc: Accusata ingiustamente di tradimento, Genoveffa viene esiliata e costretta a sopravvivere nei boschi con il figlio, affrontando fame e pericoli mentre la verità cerca di emergere.

programme.title: Beatrice Cenci
programme.desc: Bellissimo film storico sull'inchiesta della famiglia Cenci nella Roma di fine Cinquecento. La nobile famiglia Cenci è dominata dalla figura del padre Francesco (Gino Cervi), temuto per la sua crudeltà. Caccia dal castello Olimpo, l'innamorato della figlia, mentre il figlio ha un relazione con la matrigna. Scoperta la tresca, Francesco cerca di uccidere il figlio, ma le cose si complicano.

programme.title: Le baccanti
programme.desc: Splendido film storico di Giorgio Ferroni, con Taina Elg, Alberto Lupo e Alessandra Panaro. Per placare l'ira di Minerva, che ha asciugato i pozzi di Tebe, il re della città Penteo decide di compiere un sacrificio umano. Il re decide di consegnare una vergine agli dei per scongiurare la forte siccità. La fanciulla verrà difesa da Laedamo, che deciderà di sfidare il re in un grande duello.

programme.title: Afrodite, dea dell'amore
programme.desc: Tra passioni proibite, intrighi di corte e sfide al potere, Afrodite intreccia destino e seduzione nel cuore del mito. Con Anthony Steffen e Isabelle Corey.

programme.title: ...e venne il tempo di uccidere
programme.desc: Un giovane vicesceriffo cerca di riportare la sbornia e rivitalizzare uno sceriffo alcolizzato e sfinito per abbattere un paio di bande di criminali in guerra nel Vecchio West.

programme.title: I pascoli dell'odio
programme.desc: Nel 1854, Jeb Stuart, George Custer e altri laureati di West Point sono inviati in Kansas per aiutare a pacificare il territorio prima che la costruzione della ferrovia per Santa Fe possa riprendere.

programme.title: Le quattro facce del West
programme.desc: Nel Nuovo Messico, un cowboy costringe un banchiere sotto la minaccia di una pistola a concedergli un prestito senza garanzie, in cambio di una cambiale, ma lo sceriffo e la sua posse lo inseguono.

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: Durante la guerra civile un comandante sudista massacra una tribù indiana e rapisce la figlia del capo. La giovane fugge e trova rifugio presso un allevatore rozzo, ostile agli indiani ma nemico dei sudisti. Insieme stringono un'alleanza inattesa per vendicarsi degli uomini del forte.

programme.desc: Il cacciatore di taglie Jonathan Corbett è stato assunto per catturare un giovane messicano accusato di stupro.

programme.desc: Il feroce pistolero Sabata protegge i deboli e caccia un sindaco corrotto che ha truffato un'intera città.
